patternCandidates.name: Task checklist page (verify N items before unlocking)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain must complete several independent verification tasks (photos/docs) before an action (go on duty) unlocks.
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader(back, title, Help) > hero image 360x202 > title Bold 24 > stack of TaskRow (gap16) > sticky footer: Primary Large 'Complete' disabled until all rows verified + optional helper text + Tertiary-Info small link with trailing arrow ('Apply for merch')
components: Button (Large Primary, Small Tertiary-Info, Small Secondary Help)
patternCandidates.variations: Footer with/without escape link; copy long vs short.
patternCandidates.conflicts: Escape link present only on initial frame; footer overlaps last row by 12px.

patternCandidates.name: TaskRow (status list row)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: One actionable item in a checklist, showing status.
patternCandidates.structure: Card row 328w, pad12, gap8, r12, white, 1px Border/Neutral/Light, shadow; 44x44 thumbnail + label (Body/Moderate/Med 16) + optional caption (Body/Small/Reg 14; success #058743 'Verified' / error #c42925 'Failed! Retry') + trailing 24 icon (Right Arrow_Stroke = todo/retry, Check_Circle_Filled = done)

patternCandidates.name: Live camera capture with verify overlay
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain must take a live photo (no gallery) that is auto-verified.
patternCandidates.structure: Dark InternalPageHeader > full-bleed camera > bottom 75% black panel (title 20 SemiBold white + guidance 14 + shutter) ; then centred overlay card on 75% scrim: Verifying (spinner) → Success (green check) or Failure (red !, title, body, Retry)
patternCandidates.conflicts: Runway Toast instance used as centred modal; dark header is from another library

patternCandidates.name: Home status nudge card
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Blocking prerequisite or status that the captain must act on before/after going on duty.
patternCandidates.structure: Card 328x122 on off-duty home below header: left title SemiBold 18 + sub/body + text link; right 114-126 illustration with status badge (verify/green, error/red)
patternCandidates.variations: pending/failed/success; zone card is same anatomy

patternCandidates.name: Explainer bottom sheet before a task flow
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Explain requirements before starting a multi-step task.
patternCandidates.structure: Scrim + floating close X above sheet > illustration 180 > title Bold 24 > bullet list Regular 16 > red note > Primary Large with leading icon ('Start')
patternCandidates.conflicts: Off-duty home behind uses old header

patternCandidates.name: Blocking/error result bottom sheet
patternCandidates.whenToUse: An action failed or captain is blocked; single acknowledgement.
patternCandidates.structure: Scrim + close X > sheet: illustration with red alert badge > title (red for error or neutral) > body > Primary 'Okay'

patternCandidates.name: Confirm-switch sheet with consequence warning
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Switching state that has side effects (lose incentives).
patternCandidates.structure: Sheet title question > from → to chips > warning box (orange triangle 'Warning! Your incentives will be reset to 0') > Primary 'Yes, Switch Zone' + Secondary 'Go Back'
patternCandidates.variations: Modal version with audio for workspace switch

patternCandidates.name: Success confirmation card on scrim
patternCandidates.structure: Scrim + close X > card with light-green gradient top, big green check badge, bold subject + regular result text
patternCandidates.conflicts: Not a Runway component; similar to Toast overlay success

patternCandidates.name: Selectable list in bottom sheet over map + sticky confirm
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Choose one option tied to geography (zone).
patternCandidates.structure: Map 280 with back/locate > sheet with radio cards (special 'Free' option, 'Or' divider, option cards with tag/name/benefit/distance, disabled cards greyed) > sticky CTA bar (helper caption + Primary 'Confirm Zone')
patternCandidates.conflicts: Uses local Zone card instead of Runway RadioButton card

patternCandidates.name: Info page with date strip, filter chips and status cards
patternCandidates.structure: Header + Secondary tabs > date strip > audio guide > filter chips with counts > explainer image > status cards (Live/Coming/Ended/Missed) > accordions > cross-sell

patternCandidates.name: Empty orders with cross-space nudge
patternCandidates.structure: 'Searching for orders...' + Refresh > 'or' > card with title, body, service icons, primary CTA
